hypothesis: The three out-of-play contact-centering courses saturate the 0.15 m lateral task-space target before impact. Raising only the diagnostic target cap to 0.20 m with the same -0.04 m lead may center actual contact without losing clean foot contact.
common_setup: Frozen SONIC/actor/asset/parent/course, 0.95 m swing acquisition, 0.08 m forward, independent one-G1/one-ball physical process per arm.
development_gate: All three out-of-play courses move to <=4 m maximum lateral excursion; all five preserve clean foot-only contact and pelvis >=0.65 m; two good controls remain forward >=1 m and lateral ratio <=0.3. Otherwise reject.
